findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_federal_grant_profile_v2_beta" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Use this opt-in free-beta tool only when the user wants to test opportunity 359701 against current actual non-personal organization, project, and readiness fact…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_grant_document_manifest, search_federal_grants · Private data: get_grant_document_manifest, analyze_nofo_requirements, compare_grant_amendments, analyze_federal_grant, submit_federal_grant_profile_v2_beta · Public sink: get_grant_document_manifest, analyze_nofo_requirements, compare_grant_amendments, search_federal_grants, get_federal_grant_evidence_pack, submit_federal_grant_profile_v2_beta.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_grant_document_manifest, search_federal_grants · Private data: get_grant_document_manifest, analyze_nofo_requirements, compare_grant_amendments, analyze_federal_grant, submit_federal_grant_profile_v2_beta · Public sink: get_grant_document_manifest, analyze_nofo_requirements, compare_grant_amendments, search_federal_grants, get_federal_grant_evidence_pack, submit_federal_grant_profile_v2_beta

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
